# roundupcancerlawyers.com

> rounduplawyer.com is a legal resource by The Alvarez Law Firm, based in Coral Gables, Florida. The site provides information about Roundup cancer lawsuits — Non-Hodgkin Lymphoma, B-cell Lymphoma, Leukemia, Multiple Myeloma, and other glyphosate-linked blood cancers — with a focus on strict product liability claims against Monsanto and Bayer. Led by Alex Alvarez, Board Certified Civil Trial Lawyer, and Herb Borroto, M.D., J.D., Medical-Legal Expert. The firm has recovered over $100 million from Big Tobacco using the same defective-product framework it applies to Roundup cases.

## Main Pages

- [rounduplawyer.com — Home](https://www.roundupcancerlawyers.com): Roundup cancer lawsuits, our strict-liability edge, and how The Alvarez Law Firm holds Monsanto and Bayer accountable.

## Practice Areas & Case Information

- [Non-Hodgkin Lymphoma Roundup Lawsuit](https://www.roundupcancerlawyers.com/non-hodgkin-lymphoma-lawsuit.html): The cancer most strongly tied to Roundup. Coverage of all NHL subtypes — DLBCL, Follicular, Marginal Zone, Mantle Cell, Burkitt, T-cell lymphomas, and more.
- [B-cell Lymphoma Roundup Lawsuit](https://www.roundupcancerlawyers.com/b-cell-lymphoma-lawsuit.html): DLBCL, Follicular Lymphoma, Marginal Zone Lymphoma, Mantle Cell Lymphoma, Burkitt Lymphoma, Lymphoplasmacytic Lymphoma / Waldenstrom, SLL, and Hairy Cell Leukemia.
- [Leukemia & CLL Roundup Lawsuit](https://www.roundupcancerlawyers.com/leukemia-lawsuit.html): Chronic Lymphocytic Leukemia, Small Lymphocytic Lymphoma, and Hairy Cell Leukemia after glyphosate exposure.
- [Multiple Myeloma Roundup Lawsuit](https://www.roundupcancerlawyers.com/multiple-myeloma-lawsuit.html): Plasma cell cancers in farmers, applicators, and other heavy-exposure workers.

- Defendants: Monsanto Company; Bayer AG; Bayer CropScience
- Lead Theory: Strict product liability (design defect), supported by failure to warn, negligence, and concealment

- Consultation: Free
- Fee Structure: Contingency (No Fees Unless We Recover Money for You)

## What Makes The Firm Different

- Most Roundup lawyers run failure-to-warn claims. The Alvarez Law Firm leads with strict product liability — the theory that Roundup is unreasonably dangerous as designed, regardless of any warning. This is the same framework the firm has used to recover over $100 million from Big Tobacco.
- Alex Alvarez is a Board Certified Civil Trial Lawyer, certified by the National Board of Trial Advocacy — a distinction held by less than 1% of Florida attorneys.
- Herb Borroto holds both a medical degree (M.D.) and a law degree (J.D.). He personally reviews pathology, oncology charts, immunohistochemistry, and bone marrow biopsies for every Roundup case — a level of in-house medical expertise most firms cannot match.

## Reference Documents Used In Cases

- IARC Monograph Vol. 112 (2015) — Glyphosate classified as Group 2A "probably carcinogenic to humans"
- The "Monsanto Papers" — Internal Monsanto documents released through Roundup litigation
- Federal Roundup MDL 2741 (Northern District of California)
- Agricultural Health Study and other peer-reviewed cohort and case-control studies

## Sources Cited On Site

Each page on this site carries a "Sources" section at the bottom citing primary sources (IARC, EPA, NIH/NCI, U.S. District Court for the Northern District of California, American Cancer Society, peer-reviewed PubMed-indexed studies). The Alvarez Law Firm relies on government, academic, and peer-reviewed publications — not commercial summaries — for all factual claims about glyphosate, Roundup, and the linked blood cancers.
